blog_figures.caption: 两种石头：代理压输入，技能压输出

card.heading: 两种「石头」
points: 大石头（the proxy）：本地代理，压缩 Agent 读进来的内容
小石头（the skill）：纯输出压缩，只让回答变短，不碰输入
技能包安装最轻，兼容面最广
代理跑在本机，用你自己的密钥与登录态

blog_figures.anchor: 快速上手：先看它省不省
blog_figures.caption: 官方自检命令顺序
blog_figures.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[caveman learn] --> B[caveman learn implement]
  B --> C[caveman trial -- claude]
  C --> D[caveman shrink -- pnpm test]
  D --> E[caveman browse url]
  E --> F[caveman stats]

code_blocks.content:
node -v
npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman -g
npm install -g @caveman-ai/cli && caveman setup --install
caveman claude
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/v3.2.0/install.ps1 | iex
npx -y github:JuliusBrussee/caveman -- --uninstall

code_blocks.anchor: 快速上手：先看它省不省
code_blocks.content:
caveman learn
caveman learn implement
caveman trial -- claude
caveman shrink -- pnpm test
caveman browse <url>
caveman stats

xhs.one_liner: 给编码 Agent 用的省 token 方案：说话变短，读的东西变小
